name: Wireless TWS Earbuds
subtitle: Bluetooth 5.0 earbuds with touch controls
description: FUSION GADGETS Wireless TWS Earbuds feature Bluetooth 5.0 connectivity, touch-sensitive controls, stereo audio, and a built-in microphone for calls. The in-ear earbuds provide up to 5 hours of playback per charge, while the compact case supplies additional charging backup.
story: These true wireless earbuds are designed for everyday listening, calls, and video without a cable connecting them to your phone. Pair them with compatible Android or iOS devices through Bluetooth, then use the touch controls to manage playback, tracks, and calls. The compact charging case stores and recharges the earbuds between listening sessions. Their lightweight in-ear form suits commuting, workdays, and general travel, while actual battery performance can vary with volume, usage, and connection conditions.

specs.additional_playback: Extra backup playback with charging case
specs.compatible_devices: Android and iOS smartphones with Bluetooth support

shipping: Estimated delivery in around 7 days. Delivery may arrive earlier or take longer depending on your destination and carrier.
